title: 3-Day Science Webinar, Kirori Mal College Delhi
teaser: 3-day science webinar at Kirori Mal College, Delhi, jointly organised by tAcT and Indian Academy of Sciences. Three lectures on 9–11 November 2020: virology, gene editing, and data science in health research.
homepageMatter: tAcT and the Indian Academy of Sciences jointly organised a 3-day science webinar at Kirori Mal College, Delhi, from 9 to 11 November 2020. Three talks were delivered: Saumitra Das on Hepatitis C virus, V. Nagaraja on gene-editing technologies, and Partha P. Majumder on data science in human health and disease.
